The '''''Carnage''''' was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] and flagship of the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Achelon]]. During the [[Galactic War]], the ''Carnage'' fought a Republic fleet over [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Moffs [[Valion Pyron]], [[Dolus]], [[Graham]] and [[Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] were discussing an alliance and decided to use this opportunity to test out the ''[[Doombringer]]''{{'s}} [[Silencer (superweapon)|Silencer]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] against the fleet that was engaged against the ''Carnage''.
